headline: Johnson Controls International (JCI) After Q3 Earnings Is The Upside Still Priced In
summary: Why Johnson Controls International stock is in focus after Q3 earnings Johnson Controls International (JCI) is back on investors’ radar after its third quarter earnings release for the period ended June 30, 2026, highlighted fresh revenue and earnings figures across its building solutions portfolio.
